mapper.select: SELECT m.permission FROM sys_menu m WHERE m.status = 1 AND m.deleted = 0 AND m.permission IS NOT NULL AND m.permission != '' AND ( EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM sys_user_role admin_ur INNER JOIN sys_role admin_r ON admin_ur.role_id = admin_r.id AND admin_r.status = 1 AND admin_r.deleted = 0 WHERE admin_ur.user_id = #{userId} AND admin_r.role_code = 'ADMIN' ) OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM sys_user_role ur INNER JOIN sys_role r ON ur.role_id = r.id AND r.status = 1 AND r.deleted = 0 INNER JOIN sys_role_menu rm ON r.id = rm.role_id WHERE ur.user_id = #{userId} AND rm.menu_id = m.id ) ) GROUP BY m.permission ORDER BY MIN(m.sort_order) ASC
SELECT role_id FROM sys_user_role WHERE user_id = #{userId}
SELECT DISTINCT r.role_code FROM sys_user_role ur INNER JOIN sys_role r ON ur.role_id = r.id AND r.status = 1 AND r.deleted = 0 WHERE ur.user_id = #{userId}
